acquisition_method: Data acquisition was executed in data dependent mode with full MS scans acquired in the Orbitrap mass analyzer
alkylation_concentration: treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.
alkylation_reagent: treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.
cleavage_agent: treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.
enrichment_method: All peptides were C-terminal biotinylated so that peptide pull-down experiments could be carried out with streptavidin beads (Dynabeads streptavidin T1, Thermo fisher, 65602).
fractionation_method: Proteins from SILAC pull-down experiments were separated by SDS-PAGE and subjected to in-gel tryptic digest.
fragmentation_method: followed by collision induced dissociation (CID) analysis of fragment ions in the ion trap
labeling: For stable isotope labeling, Hela cells were cultured in DMEM medium for SILAC (Thermo fisher, cat # 88364)
mass_analyzer: full MS scans acquired in the Orbitrap mass analyzer
reduction_concentration: treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.
reduction_reagent: treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.

instrument.evidence: analyzed with an Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
